'''Grada Zusi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked supplying [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] of the [[Bounty Supply Company]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Zusi operated out of the [[Cartel Bazaar]] section of [[Carrick Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]]. While working Zusi wore a [[Color/Legends|blue]] and brown [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] and brown pants. He spoke a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]] to his customers, and had no [[Hair/Legends|hair]], [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grada Zusi first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released in [[2011]]. In the game he acts as a Bounty Supply vendor, accepting Cartel Certificates as payment as well as [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TOR" />
